CHR_001.name: Milo
CHR_001.prompt: MILO, an 8-year-old boy, 4 heads tall with a big round head, small torso and stubby limbs; warm light-tan skin, messy chestnut-brown hair with one upright cowlick, big round dark-brown eyes with a white highlight, five freckles across the nose; mustard-yellow hoodie with a small white star patch on the left chest, navy shorts, white socks, red sneakers with white soles
CHR_001.anim_lock: Milo - 4 heads tall, chestnut hair with single cowlick, mustard hoodie with white star patch, navy shorts, red sneakers
CHR_001.proportions: 4 heads tall; head width = shoulder width; hands are 4-finger cartoon hands.
CHR_001.movement: Bouncy and quick with big anticipation and overshoot; tiptoes when sneaking; hair cowlick springs on every stop.
CHR_001.reference_requirements: Turnaround (front, 3/4, side, back) on white; expression sheet of 8; pajama variant (light-blue pajamas with yellow moons) for night scenes.

variants.PAJAMAS: light-blue pajamas with small yellow crescent moons replace the hoodie, shorts and sneakers; barefoot

CHR_032.name: Captain Tot
CHR_032.prompt: CAPTAIN TOT, a fingertip-sized old sea captain with a round body, navy pea coat with brass buttons, white captain's cap, big fluffy white beard, rosy nose, holding a brass spyglass
CHR_032.anim_lock: Captain Tot - tiny round captain, navy pea coat, white cap, fluffy white beard, brass spyglass
CHR_032.proportions: 3 heads tall; beard covers the chest.
CHR_032.movement: Brave, stocky, braces against wind; salutes.
CHR_032.reference_requirements: Model sheet at macro scale; spyglass pose.
